verdict.rationale: Sardine is a SaaS fraud and compliance platform, and such a product could publish source under an open license, so the axis applies. The evidence describes a 'proprietary SDK', a 'proprietary no-code rule editor', and gated 'protected documentation'. Nothing shows any source code released under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
